issue.detail: Spec says synchronous reset but does not specify whether reset is sampled on negedge (as contract assumes) or posedge; contract uses negedge for both reset and data.
issue.spec_evidence: Create 8 D flip-flops with active high synchronous reset.
issue.alternative: Reset is sampled on the positive edge of clk while data is sampled on the negative edge.

issue.detail: Spec does not define behavior when reset is asserted and d changes; contract assumes reset dominates and q becomes 0x34 regardless of d.
issue.spec_evidence: Create 8 D flip-flops with active high synchronous reset.
issue.alternative: When reset is high, q holds previous value instead of loading 0x34.
